text: Teaching Objective This program will enable students to be qualified personnel with advanced technology and engineering knowledge of safety and environmental science and related disciplines. It will help students to develop all-round morality, intellectuality and physical fitness in order to meet the needs of modern industrial development. Graduates will be capable of working in the fields of design, research, monitoring, evaluation, supervising and management related with safety and environmental engineering. Main Courses The degree courses are: Elementary Chinese (Oral Chinese, Intensive Chinese and Extensive Chinese), A Survey of China, Advanced Math, Physics, Fundamental Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Engineering of Safety System, Risk Assessment, Environmental Monitoring Technology, Air Pollution Control Engineering, Information Technology of Safety Enghineering, Water Treatment Engineer, Environment Quality Appraisement, Safety Mornitoring, Solid Waste Treatment Engineering. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded The qualified students will be awarded the Master Degree of Engineering.
